description:
Goal

A demanded callable TransportShape(position) monotonically refines exact carried producer/use relations into one physical representation. ABI, backend, interpreter, and native consumers use that answer directly; no layer reselects producer identity from types, joined demand surfaces, ShapeIds, ordering, or session inventories.

North-star contract

- There is no transport seal, completion pass, whole-world census, or no-change completion signal.
- One requested product produces from exact current fact/product reads or returns exact waits.
- Completion is relative to the exact OutgoingEdgeFrontier generation already requested by the product DAG; later demand moves that generation.
- Dependency states/generations are memo metadata, never ProductValue data.
- Only an actual product back-edge may require local cyclic settlement. A recursive dependency cone is not automatically an SCC.
- Refinement preserves upstream identity and relations; it never reconstructs them from a physical summary.

Proven defect

Spike bf021f6fecba4f0db57989dbb4aafa92de3a2ae3 traced the paired Enum.drop_while multi-producer slot reduce_while_cont input 2.

The legacy solve projected 25 executables, 207 equality components, and 408 positions. The requested component itself had one position, one anchor, and zero equalities. It is not an SCC. Its slot had two carried sources; each independently projected Exact to a distinct callable ShapeId. callable_input_shapes_for_demand accepted neither, so aggregate projection became Unknown and installed a generic fallback. Reversing publisher order produced the same loss. The physical selector discarded already-valid producer relations and reconstructed eligibility from joined rendering.

The recursive projection touched 18 executable contexts. That measures a dependency cone; it does not prove that all members are necessary or cyclic.

Established foundation

fz-k22.5.1 now provides immutable revisioned products, durable exact fact/product dependencies, final FactMovement states, atomic requested-publisher frontier generations, replaceable OutgoingInputEdges(E) contributions, IncomingInputRelations(root), exact IncomingInputSlot(slot) projections, and targeted closure retraction. This ticket consumes those authorities; it does not rebuild or compensate for them.

Required refinement

TransportShape(Input) must read the current IncomingInputSlot, pull the exact TransportShape(Value(producer, value)) children named by every carried relation, and derive their common physical ABI.

- Zero carried relations is incomplete or absent according to the exact upstream domain; it is not permission to invent a semantic fallback.
- One relation may use a direct representation only when carried authority says direct-only. Otherwise it uses the public carrier.
- Multiple producer identities retain every alternative and use their common public boxed callable ABI. Physical equality never chooses semantic identity.
- Callable construction remains a separate producer-position product.
- CallableFacts and BoundaryFacts derive from named construction/publication products or wait.

Proof-first strategy

1. In a temporary ticket worktree, trace the requested paired input from IncomingInputSlot through its producer values and identify the last authoritative local data for positions, equalities, anchors, callable producer descriptors, and semantic mappings.
2. Prototype the narrow position-product DAG without changing production behavior. Prove every edge is a monotone refinement of named upstream facts/products, and classify actual back-edges before proposing any local SCC settlement.
3. Falsify the candidate on zero, one-direct, one-public, multiple-distinct, recursive, replacement, withdrawal, and forward/reverse schedules. Measure pulled products and prove unrelated components stay cold.
4. Only after the boundary is proven, implement it test-first and delete the legacy whole-closure solve, snapshot facades, physical selector/fallback, manufactured demand, custom freshness ledgers, and obsolete cache/resource tests in the same atomic commit.
5. Update northstar and durable docs to describe the resulting product vocabulary. Remove all spike probes and scaffolding.

A candidate local source product may carry positions, equality/anchor recipes, input-slot references, callable producer descriptors, and already-selected semantic mappings for one executable. It must not project ShapeIds, read neighboring contexts, or duplicate authoritative facts. Historical ExecutableTransportFacts performed context-sensitive projection and is not reusable.

Signal

- The paired input pulls both producer-value children and no unrelated component.
- Both valid producers survive into one public callable ABI; same-layout distinct identities cannot cross-select.
- Exact requests, reads, waits, generations, replacement, withdrawal, and child products are observable through production telemetry/tests.
- Forward and reverse schedules produce equal product values and generations without debug/render sorting.
- Whole-closure projection, snapshot inventories, selector/fallback logic, manufactured demand, and custom closure freshness state are deleted, not bypassed.
- Lower layers consume the final transport answer without reconstruction.
- Full library tests, targeted behavior fixtures, strict all-target clippy, formatting, and a before/after product/work measurement pass.

Scope

No production implementation begins until the raw-source/position boundary and any genuine product cycle are proven in the spike. fz-k22.30 remains blocked here. fz-k22.31 owns the uncalled first-class discrepancy. fz-k22.29 may consume the eventual authority only after it exists.
title: Make callable transport determination a product-owned refinement
